tracks.title: Amazing Grace
tracks.performer: Kevin MacLeod · Steel Guitar RAG lesson edit
tracks.description: Kevin MacLeod’s recognizable recording, adapted into a complete beginner waltz lesson with a two-bar count-in, synchronized words, and one continuity-first E9 route.
tracks.teachingFocus: Open and pedals-down changes on strings 4–5–6
tracks.recordingCredit: “Amazing Grace 2011” Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 3.0
tracks.arrangementRightsBasis: CC BY 3.0 adaptation of the licensed Kevin MacLeod recording
tracks.masterOwner: Kevin MacLeod; Steel Guitar RAG lesson edit distributed under the source CC BY 3.0 license
tracks.masterRightsBasis: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported permits sharing and adaptation with attribution, license link, and an indication of modifications
tracks.performerCredits: Kevin MacLeod · clarinet, pipe organ, and piano recording; no steel-guitar part
tracks.modifications: First 16-bar verse extracted, transposed from C to G, slowed from 79 to 76 BPM, two-bar count-in added, and lesson chord/beat/lyric timeline hand-authored. No endorsement by Kevin MacLeod is implied.
tracks.chart: [Opening] | G | G | C | G | [Middle] G | G | D7 | D7 | G | G | C | G | [Ending] Em | D7 | G | G |
tracks.lyricAlignment: Phrase text begins on the audible melody pickup at count-in beat six (3947 ms), one beat before the first full-bar downbeat.

lyricCues.text: Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost, but now am found
Was blind, but now I see
